batch: ICAS 2022 Year 2 Mathematics（30 题全卷，中英双语）

stem.en: How many flowers are in the vase?
stem.zh: 花瓶里一共有多少朵花？

solution.en: Count them one by one: there are {n} flowers in the vase.
solution.zh: 一朵一朵指着数：花瓶里一共有 {n} 朵花。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 一定会发生／可能发生／一定不会发生

stem.zh: 看下图：今天是 6 月 {d} 日，星期一，天气晴朗。下面哪一句说的是「一定」会发生的事？
stem.en: Look at the picture: today is Monday {d} June and it is sunny. Which statement is CERTAIN to happen?

options.zh: 下星期一将会是 6 月 {d+7} 日

options.en: It will be sunny tomorrow as well

solution.zh: 今天是星期一，所以明天是星期二，「明天是星期四」一定不会发生。天气明天可能晴也可能不晴，只是「可能」。但今天是 6 月 {d} 日星期一，再过 7 天（下星期一）一定是 6 月 {d+7} 日 —— 这是「一定」。
solution.en: Today is Monday, so tomorrow is Tuesday: "Thursday tomorrow" will NOT happen. Tomorrow's weather only MIGHT be sunny. But Monday {d} June plus 7 days is always {d+7} June, so that one is certain.

stem.zh: 杰丝用小棒搭图形：图形 1、图形 2、图形 3 的样子如下图。照这个规律，搭图形 {n} 一共要用多少根小棒？
stem.en: Jess makes shapes with sticks. Shapes 1, 2 and 3 are shown below. Following the same pattern, how many sticks does she need to make shape {n}?

solution.zh: 仔细看图：每多搭一个三角形，新三角形都和原来的共用一条边，所以只需要再加 2 根小棒。图形 1 用 3 根、图形 2 用 5 根、图形 3 用 7 根……图形 {n} 就是 3 + 2×({n}−1) = {2*n+1} 根。
solution.en: Each new triangle shares a side with the previous one, so every extra triangle only needs 2 more sticks: 3, 5, 7, … Shape {n} needs 3 + 2×({n}−1) = {2*n+1} sticks.

stem.en: Max was drawing a hexagon and had drawn {k} sides. How many more sides does he need to draw to finish it?
stem.zh: 马克在画一个六边形，已经画了 {k} 条边。他还要再画几条边才能画完这个六边形？

solution.en: A hexagon has 6 sides. {k} are drawn, so {6-k} more are needed.
solution.zh: 六边形有 6 条边。已经画了 {k} 条，还缺 6−{k}＝{6-k} 条。

stem.zh: 莉兹用下图里的数字卡片摆了一个两位数（每张卡片只能用一次）：个位数字比十位数字大 {d}。她摆的两位数是多少？
stem.en: Liz used the digit cards below to make a two-digit number (each card used once). The units digit is {d} more than the tens digit. What number did she make?

solution.zh: 从卡片 2、3、4、6、9 里找相差 {d} 的两张：只有 {t} 和 {u} 这一对，所以十位是 {t}、个位是 {u}，两位数是 {10*t+u}。
solution.en: Among the cards 2, 3, 4, 6 and 9, only {t} and {u} differ by {d}, so the tens digit is {t} and the units digit is {u}: {10*t+u}.

stem.en: Look at the picture. Which shape was NOT used in the picture?
stem.zh: 看这幅画。下面哪种形状在画里「没有」用到？

solution.en: Find every shape you can see in the picture, then compare with the options — the one you cannot find is the answer.
solution.zh: 把画里能看到的形状逐一找出来（窗户、门、墙、门把手），再和选项一一对照，找不到的那一种就是答案。

stem.en: On the number line, the distance from 0 to {E} is divided into {n} equal parts. The arrow points at the {k}th mark from 0. What number is shown at the arrow?
stem.zh: 一条数轴上，0 到 {E} 之间被平均分成了 {n} 小格。箭头指在从 0 数起的第 {k} 格刻度上，这个刻度表示多少？

solution.en: Each part is {E}÷{n}＝{E/n}. The {k}th mark is {k}×{E/n}＝{k*E/n}.
solution.zh: 每小格表示 {E}÷{n}＝{E/n}。第 {k} 格就是 {k}×{E/n}＝{k*E/n}。

stem.zh: 杰克收到四个礼物盒（如下图）。红色虚线框标出的那个盒子，打开后他最可能找到什么？
stem.en: Jack received four present boxes (diagram below). The box marked with the red dashed outline — what would he most likely find inside?

solution.zh: 看盒子的形状：又长又扁的最大盒子装滑板；又高又窄的装篮球；最小的装手表；中等偏大的装鞋子。
solution.en: Match the shape: the long flat box holds a skateboard, the tall narrow box a ball, the smallest a watch, the medium box shoes.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 象形统计图：比某队恰好多 2 球

stem.zh: 下图是四支球队上一场比赛进球数的象形统计图（每个球代表 1 个进球）。哪一支队进的球正好比鹰队多 2 个？
stem.en: The pictograph below shows the goals four teams scored in their last game (each ball = 1 goal). Which team scored exactly 2 more goals than the Hawks?

solution.zh: 先从图上数出鹰队是 {c2} 个球。比 {c2} 多 2 就是 {T} 个，再到图上找进球数是 {T} 的那一队，就是答案。
solution.en: Read the Hawks from the graph: {c2} goals. Two more than {c2} is {T}; find the column with {T} balls in the graph.

stem.zh: 看下图的算式（每个图形代表一个数）。◆ ＋ ✿ − ❁ 等于多少？
stem.en: Look at the equations below (each shape stands for a number). What is ◆ + ✿ − ❁ ?

solution.en: From the picture ◆＝{a}, ✿＝{b}, ❁＝{c}, so {a}+{b}−{c}＝{a+b-c}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 选出三张和为定值的卡片（多选）

stem.zh: 从下图五张卡片中选出「三张」，使三张卡片上的数加起来正好是 {T}。（点选三张卡片）
stem.en: Choose THREE of the five cards below so that the three numbers add up to exactly {T}.

solution.zh: 把三张卡片相加试试：{v1}＋{v3}＋{v4}＝{T}，正好符合，所以选这三张。
solution.en: {v1}+{v3}+{v4}＝{T}, so these three cards are the answer.

stem.en: It is now {h} o'clock. Which clock shows a time that is half an hour LATER than now?
stem.zh: 现在是 {h} 点整。哪个钟显示的时间比现在「快半小时」？

solution.en: Half an hour later than {h}:00 is {h}:30. Find the clock whose hands show {h}:30.
solution.zh: 「快半小时」就是多走半小时：{h} 点再过半小时是 {h}:30。找出指针正好指向 {h}:30 的那个钟。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 电梯上上下下（出到地上楼层）

stem.zh: 卡拉从下图这栋楼的 B{b} 层进了电梯。电梯上升了 {u} 层，又下降了 {d} 层，然后她出了电梯。她是在地上几楼出的电梯？（G 是地面层，地上从 1 楼数起）
stem.en: Cara got into the lift at level B{b} of the building below. She went up {u} levels, then down {d} levels, and got out. What floor ABOVE ground did she get out at? (G is the ground floor; floors above count from 1.)

solution.zh: 把 B{b} 层当成 −{b}：从 −{b} 出发，上升 {u} 层、下降 {d} 层，就是 −{b}＋{u}−{d}＝{0-b+u-d}。结果是正数，说明在地面以上，也就是地上 {0-b+u-d} 楼。
solution.en: Treat B{b} as −{b}: −{b}+{u}−{d}＝{0-b+u-d}. A positive answer means above ground, so she got out at floor {0-b+u-d}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 电梯上上下下（出到地下楼层）

stem.zh: 卡拉从下图这栋楼的 B{b} 层进了电梯。电梯上升了 {u} 层，又下降了 {d} 层，然后她出了电梯。她是在地下哪一层出的电梯？（B1 是地下 1 层）
stem.en: Cara got into the lift at level B{b} of the building below. She went up {u} levels, then down {d} levels, and got out. What level BELOW ground did she get out at? (B1 is one level below ground.)

solution.zh: 把 B{b} 层当成 −{b}：−{b}＋{u}−{d}＝{0-b+u-d}。结果是负数，说明仍在地下，就是 B{0-(0-b+u-d)} 层。
solution.en: Treat B{b} as −{b}: −{b}+{u}−{d}＝{0-b+u-d}. Negative means below ground, i.e. level B{0-(0-b+u-d)}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 数一数两种车一共有几辆

stem.zh: 下图是玛丽在公交站数到的车（划记统计表，每 5 个一组）。她看到的小汽车和卡车一共有多少辆？
stem.en: The tally chart below shows the vehicles Mary counted at the bus stop (tally marks in groups of 5). How many cars and trucks did she see altogether?

solution.zh: 从图上数划记：小汽车 {a} 辆，卡车 {c} 辆，一共 {a}＋{c}＝{a+c} 辆。
solution.en: Count the tallies: {a} cars and {c} trucks, so {a}+{c}＝{a+c}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 吃一半再吃一半，还剩几颗

stem.en: Kurt picked some strawberries. He ate half on Friday and half of what was left on Saturday, leaving {L}. How many strawberries did he pick altogether?
stem.zh: 库尔特摘了一些草莓。他周五吃掉了一半，周六又吃掉了剩下的一半，最后还剩 {L} 颗。库尔特一共摘了多少颗草莓？

solution.en: Work backwards: {L} left means before Saturday there were {L}×2＝{2*L}; before Friday there were {2*L}×2＝{4*L}. He picked {4*L} in all.
solution.zh: 倒着推：剩下 {L} 颗，说明周六吃之前有 {L}×2＝{2*L} 颗；周五吃之前有 {2*L}×2＝{4*L} 颗。一共摘了 {4*L} 颗。

templates.noFigure: 原题为纯文字应用题（草莓吃一半再吃一半），无图

stem.en: Look at the bookshelf. What colour is the book on shelf {r} counted from the top and position {c} counted from the right?
stem.zh: 看书架图。从上数第 {r} 层、从右数第 {c} 本是什么颜色的书？

solution.en: Count the shelves from the top down to number {r}, then count {c} books from the right. Read that book's colour.
solution.zh: 从上往下数到第 {r} 层，再从右往左数到第 {c} 本，读出它的颜色。

stem.en: A stick is divided into {k} equal segments, coloured red and white (see the diagram below). What is half of the stick in segments?
stem.zh: 一根小棍被平均分成了 {k} 小段，涂成红白相间（如下图）。这根小棍的一半是多少小段？

solution.en: Half means split the {k} segments into two equal parts: {k}÷2＝{k/2} segments.
solution.zh: 一半就是把 {k} 段平均分成两份：{k}÷2＝{k/2} 段。

stem.zh: 四个小伙伴围成一圈轮流往下倒数，数数的顺序和头几个数如下图。照这样数下去，「{n}」会轮到谁说？
stem.en: Four friends take turns counting backwards around a circle; the order and the first few numbers are shown below. Who will say "{n}"?

solution.zh: 从图上看，甲、乙、丙、丁依次报一个数，四个人轮一圈。从 {S} 数到 {n} 一共报了 {S}−{n}＝{S-n} 个数，{S-n}÷4 的余数是 {(S-n)%4}，所以是第 {(S-n)%4+1} 个人报的，也就是答案。
solution.en: From the picture the turn order is a four-person cycle. From {S} down to {n} is {S}−{n}＝{S-n} numbers; the remainder of {S-n}÷4 is {(S-n)%4}, so it is the {(S-n)%4+1}th person in the cycle.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 正方形围栏要多少根柱子

stem.en: A farmer wants a square paddock. He puts {p} posts on each side, with one post at each corner (corner posts are shared by two sides). How many posts does he need in total?
stem.zh: 农场主要围一块正方形的地。每条边上立 {p} 根柱子，四个角各有一根（角上的柱子两条边共用）。他一共要用多少根柱子？

solution.en: Simply 4×{p}＝{4*p} would count each corner post twice, so subtract 4. Total = 4×{p}−4＝{4*p-4} posts.
solution.zh: 如果直接 4×{p}＝{4*p}，四个角的柱子就被数了两次，要多减去 4。所以一共 4×{p}−4＝{4*p-4} 根。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 比多比少求总数

stem.en: Abdi has {a} marbles. Jenny has {m} more than Abdi. Peter has {k} fewer than Jenny. How many marbles do the three have altogether?
stem.zh: 阿布迪有 {a} 颗弹珠。珍妮比阿布迪多 {m} 颗，彼得比珍妮少 {k} 颗。他们三人一共有多少颗弹珠？

solution.en: Jenny has {a}＋{m}＝{a+m}; Peter has {a+m}−{k}＝{a+m-k}. Total = {a}＋{a+m}＋{a+m-k}＝{3*a+2*m-k}.
solution.zh: 珍妮有 {a}＋{m}＝{a+m} 颗，彼得有 {a+m}−{k}＝{a+m-k} 颗。一共 {a}＋{a+m}＋{a+m-k}＝{3*a+2*m-k} 颗。

templates.noFigure: 原题为纯文字应用题（比多比少求总数），无图

stem.en: Jamie hangs lanterns in the repeating order red, yellow, blue, green. What colour is the {n}th lantern?
stem.zh: 杰米挂灯笼，按「红、黄、蓝、绿」的顺序不断重复。第 {n} 个灯笼是什么颜色？

solution.en: 4 lanterns make one group. {n}÷4＝{n/4} groups with remainder 1; remainder 1 is the first in each group — red.
solution.zh: 4 个灯笼为一组。{n}÷4＝{n/4} 组余 1，余 1 就是每组里的第 1 个——红色。

stem.en: The wheel shows the seasons in Sydney. Which season is it in Sydney in month {m}?
stem.zh: 圆盘上是悉尼的四季。悉尼 {m} 月是什么季节？

solution.en: In Sydney: spring is Sep–Nov, summer Dec–Feb, autumn Mar–May, winter Jun–Aug. Month {m} belongs to the matching season.
solution.zh: 悉尼的四季：春天 9–11 月，夏天 12–2 月，秋天 3–5 月，冬天 6–8 月。{m} 月就属于对应的那个季节。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 用尽可能多的硬币付款

stem.zh: 安娜的钱包里有很多 5 分、10 分、20 分、50 分的硬币（如下图）。她要正好付 {amt} 分，并且想「用尽可能多的硬币」。她最多要用多少枚硬币？
stem.en: Anna has plenty of 5c, 10c, 20c and 50c coins (diagram below). She must pay exactly {amt}c and wants to use AS MANY coins as possible. What is the greatest number of coins she can use?

solution.zh: 想用的硬币最多，就要尽量用最小面值的 5 分硬币：{amt} ÷ 5 = {T}（枚），而且 {amt} 正好是 5 的倍数，所以最多 {T} 枚。
solution.en: To use the most coins, use the smallest value (5c) as much as possible: {amt} ÷ 5 = {T} coins.

stem.zh: 本的桌面铺着蓝黄相间的方砖（如下图），红色虚线框里缺了一块 2×2 的补块。补块应该是什么样子的？
stem.en: Ben's table top is tiled in a blue/yellow checker pattern (diagram below); a 2×2 patch is missing inside the red dashed box. What should the missing patch look like?

solution.zh: 把补块按桌面花纹的行列一格一格接上去：横向、纵向都是蓝黄交替，缺口从第 {rr} 行第 {cc} 列开始，四格的颜色就被唯一确定了。
solution.en: Line the patch up with the rows and columns: the pattern alternates both ways, and the gap starts at row {rr}, column {cc}, so the four colours are fixed.

stem.zh: 鲍比有三张长方形纸，下图按实际大小画出了它们（同样宽，长度不同）。黄纸的大小是红纸的 {m} 倍，红纸是蓝纸的 {k} 倍。一张黄纸能正好铺满多少张蓝纸？
stem.en: Bobby has three rectangular sheets, drawn to scale below (same width, different lengths). The yellow sheet is {m} times the size of the red sheet, and the red sheet is {k} times the size of the blue sheet. How many blue sheets exactly cover one yellow sheet?

solution.zh: 红纸是蓝纸的 {k} 倍，黄纸又是红纸的 {m} 倍，所以黄纸是蓝纸的 {k}×{m}＝{m*k} 倍 —— 要 {m*k} 张蓝纸才能正好铺满一张黄纸。
solution.en: Red is {k} times blue and yellow is {m} times red, so yellow is {k}×{m}＝{m*k} times blue: {m*k} blue sheets cover one yellow sheet.

stem.zh: 西塔的棋子（蓝点）在黑白棋盘上，马克站在棋盘的下方（如下图）。她把棋子往左移 1 格，又朝马克的方向前移 2 格。棋子最后停在哪一格？
stem.en: Sita's counter (blue dot) is on a black-and-white board and Mark stands below the board (diagram below). She moves it 1 square left and then 2 squares forward toward Mark. On which square does it land?

solution.zh: 从棋子出发，先往左 1 格，再朝马克（向下）2 格，落在第 {ar} 行第 {ac} 列（从上往下、从左往右数）。
solution.en: From the counter, 1 left then 2 toward Mark (downwards) lands on row {ar}, column {ac} (counting from the top-left).

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 池塘边的鸟：飞来又飞走

stem.zh: 池塘里原有 {s} 只鸟。蒂娜每隔 5 分钟记录一次飞来的和飞走的鸟数（见下表）。20 分钟后池塘里有多少只鸟？
stem.en: There were {s} birds on the pond. Tina recorded the birds arriving and flying away every 5 minutes (see the table). How many birds are on the pond after 20 minutes?

solution.zh: 把表里的每次变化依次算下来：{s}＋{a1}−{f1}＝{s+a1-f1}；{s+a1-f1}＋{a2}−{f2}＝{s+a1+a2-f1-f2}；再 {a3} 进 {f3} 出得 {s+a1+a2+a3-f1-f2-f3}；最后 {a4} 进 {f4} 出，得 {T} 只。
solution.en: Work through the table step by step: {s}+{a1}−{f1}＝{s+a1-f1}; then +{a2}−{f2}＝{s+a1+a2-f1-f2}; then +{a3}−{f3}＝{s+a1+a2+a3-f1-f2-f3}; finally +{a4}−{f4}＝{T}.

stem.zh: 吉娜有 {n} 块颜色不同的积木（见下图，每块颜色都不一样）。她想搭一座 {n} 层的高塔，其中绿积木必须在最底层。她能搭出多少座不一样的塔？
stem.en: Gina has {n} blocks, all different colours (see the picture). She builds towers {n} blocks high, and the green block must be at the bottom. How many different towers can she build?

solution.zh: 绿积木已经固定在最底层，剩下 {n-1} 个位置要把 {n-1} 种颜色的积木排进去：第一个位置有 {n-1} 种选法，第二个有 {n-2} 种，第三个有 {n-3} 种，所以一共 {n-1}×{n-2}×{n-3}＝{(n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3)} 座。
solution.en: Green is fixed at the bottom; the remaining {n-1} places take the other {n-1} colours: {n-1}×{n-2}×{n-3}＝{(n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3)} towers.

stem.zh: 看下图的三道算式（◆、▲、● 各代表一个数）。● 代表的数是多少？
stem.en: Look at the three equations below (◆, ▲ and ● each stand for a number). What number does ● stand for?

solution.en: Equation 2 gives ▲+●＝{B/2}. Substituting into equation 1 gives ◆＝{A}−{B/2}＝{A-B/2}. Equation 3 can be regrouped as (◆+▲+●)+◆+●+●＝{C}; with ◆+▲+●＝{A} and ◆＝{A-B/2} this gives ●+●＝{C-2*A+B/2}, so ●＝{c}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 移动最少的猪使每个圈一样多

stem.zh: 农夫乔有 A、B、C、D 四个猪圈（如下图），猪只能按箭头方向从一个圈赶到相邻的下一个圈。他想让每个猪圈的猪一样多，最少要移动多少头猪？
stem.en: Farmer Joe has four pens A, B, C and D (diagram below); pigs may only be moved in the direction of the arrows into the next pen. He wants every pen to hold the same number of pigs. What is the fewest pigs he must move?

solution.zh: 四个圈一共 {tot} 头猪，平均每个圈 {a} 头。只能按 A→B→C→D 的方向赶：A 多 {f1} 头只能给 B；B 接着多 {f2} 头给 C；C 再多 {f3} 头给 D。一共要移动 {ans} 头。
solution.en: There are {tot} pigs in all, so {a} per pen. Pigs only move A→B→C→D: A passes {f1} on, B passes {f2}, C passes {f3}. Total moved: {ans}.
